blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Spherical harmonic descriptors of closed 3D shapes depend on the parameterization, the pose and the scale of the surface, and the standard rotation-invariant reductions, the power spectrum and the bispectrum, discard the relative orientation of the harmonic bands and cannot distinguish a shape from its mirror image. We construct a descriptor that removes all three dependencies exactly and loses nothing else: a conformal parameterization normalized by its conformal barycenter, followed by polynomial invariants of the rotation group. Identifying each harmonic band with a binary form turns the rotation quotient into classical invariant theory and makes reflections visible as the sign of an invariant, so chirality is recorded. The descriptor is complete for the truncated expansion, stable in the orbit distance, and comes with numerical diagnostics. Benchmarks confirm the guarantees, and on bilateral anatomical structures the descriptor separates mirror-image pairs from asymmetric pairs, which parity-blind descriptors cannot.
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 闭合的3D形状的球形口号描述器取决于参数化,姿势和表面的尺度,以及标准的旋转-不定减速,功率谱和比谱,丢弃口号带的相对方向,无法区分一个形状与它的镜像. 我们构建了一个完全消除所有三个依赖性的描述符,并且没有任何其他损失:一个符合性参数化,由它的符合性巴音中心实现正常化,然后是自转组的多名变量。 识别每个带有二进制形态的谐波波段,将旋转商号转化为古典的无变数理论,并使反射作为无变数的标志而可见,所以奇异性被记录下来. 截断拓扑的描述器完成,轨道距离稳定,并带有数值诊断. 基准确认这些保证,在双边解剖结构上,描述符将镜像对和不对称对分开,而对等-盲描述符则不能分开。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Spherical harmonic expansions are a standard representation of closed genus-zero surfaces in shape analysis, from the SPHARM descriptors of brain structures [ 7 , 29 ] to rotation-invariant retrieval of 3D models [ 21 ] . A surface is mapped to the sphere, a coordinate or radial function is expanded in spherical harmonics, and the coefficients are used as features. The coefficients, however, depend on three choices that are not part of the shape: the map to the sphere, the position of the surface in space, and its scale. The map is the serious one. For the area-preserving parameterizations of SPHARM the residual freedom is the infinite-dimensional group of area-preserving diffeomorphisms of the sphere, so an individual coefficient is a function of the map and not of the surface; the first-order-ellipsoid alignment that follows fixes a frame by convention, is undefined when two semi-axes coincide, and leaves a finite sign ambiguity. The usual remedies remove the dependence on rotations by discarding information. The power spectrum keeps only the norm of each band and forgets how the bands are oriented relative to each other; the bispectrum [ 20 ] keeps more but its completeness and its behaviour under reflection are not known band by band; and every descriptor built from rotation-invariant quantities of even degree cannot distinguish a shape from its mirror image, which for bilateral anatomy is the difference between the left and the right side.
blocks.zh: 球形谐波膨胀是在形状分析中闭合基因-零表面的标准表示,从大脑结构的SPHARM描述符[7,29]到3D模型的旋转-不变量检索[21]. 一个表面被映射到球体上,一个坐标或射线函数在球体的谐振中被扩展,系数作为特征. 然而,系数取决于三种不属于形状的选择:球体的映射,空间中表面的位置,及其尺度. 地图是严肃的 对于SPHARM的保区参数化,剩余自由是球体无限维的保区二面体群,所以单个系数是地图的函数,而不是表面的函数;后面的一阶-椭圆形对齐通过常规固定一个框架,当两个半轴重合时没有定义,留下一定的标志模糊. 通常的补救措施通过丢弃信息来消除对旋转的依赖. 电源谱只保留每个波段的规范,忘记了波段如何相对地定向;比谱[20]保存得更多,但其完整性和反射下的行为却不为波段所知;每个由旋转-不定量均匀度所构建的描述器无法区分一个形状与其镜像,对于双边解剖学来说,这是左侧和右侧的区别.

blocks.en: This paper removes all three dependencies exactly and loses nothing else. Conformal parameterization [ 17 , 11 ] reduces the map freedom to the Möbius group, normalization by the conformal barycenter [ 3 , 9 ] reduces it to a rotation of the sphere, and the rotation is removed by polynomial invariants of the rotation group, for which the classical identification of harmonics with binary forms [ 10 , 24 ] supplies both the invariants and, through a real structure, the sign that records handedness. Position is removed by a canonical center and scale by weighted projectivization. The construction is exact at every step, and the descriptor it produces is complete for the truncated expansion. Formally, let S ⊂ ℝ 3 S\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} be a smoothly embedded two-sphere; the shape space is 𝒮 = Emb ⁡ ( 𝕊 2 , ℝ 3 ) / ( G task × Diff + ⁡ ( 𝕊 2 ) ) , \mathcal{S}=\Emb(\mathbb{S}^{2},\mathbb{R}^{3})\big/\bigl(G_{\rm task}\times\Diff^{+}(\mathbb{S}^{2})\bigr), where G task G_{\rm task} is the group of orientation-preserving rigid motions of ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} , of all rigid motions, or of orientation-preserving similarities, and the paper computes coordinates on 𝒮 \mathcal{S} at the level of truncated coefficients. Constructions of separating invariants for general compact groups, with dimension or stability guarantees, are given in [ 16 , 8 ] ; here the group and the representation are specific, and the invariants are explicit.

blocks.en: Frames, metrics, stability. On the principal stratum a canonical frame reduces the residual rotations to the Klein four-group, and the invariant monomials of degree at most three in the aligned coefficients separate orbits; the frame has no continuous extension to the degenerate strata ( Theorem 6.2 ). The orbit distance is a metric on the quotient, the invariants are Lipschitz for it on bounded sets, and on compact sets it is bounded by a Hölder power of the invariant discrepancy ( Theorem 7.3 ). Theorem 7.6 collects these properties into one statement, and Section 8 gives the numerical realization with a synthetic end-to-end test.
blocks.zh: 框架、指标、稳定性。 在主层上,一个犬形框架将剩余旋转减小至克莱因四组,在对齐系数中,学位的不常单数最多为三个分离轨道;框架没有持续延伸至退化层(定理6.2). 轨道距离是商号上的衡量标准,不变量是Lipschitz,用于在定界套上,而紧凑套上则以不变量差异的赫尔德力(定理7.3 )为界. 定理7.6将这些属性收集成一个语句,第8节给出数字实现,并进行合成端到端测试.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. On classes of dipole–quadrupole pairs that share their power spectrum and bispectrum, and on their mirror images, the power spectrum and the bispectrum classify at chance, the O ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{O}(3) -invariants reach one half, and the seven invariants of Theorem 4.9 classify all classes; the frame coordinates are ill-conditioned like the reciprocal of the spectral gap, while the invariants are not; and the measured stability exponents agree with Theorem 7.3 ( Section 9 ). On eleven bilateral pairs of a public anatomical atlas, the descriptor identifies the pairs that are one chiral shape in two handednesses, with the pseudo-invariants recording the handedness, and separates them from pairs of different shapes; the diagnostics reject the two structures on which the conformal map folds ( Section 9.4 ).
blocks.zh: 基准。 在分享其动力谱和双光谱的二极管-quadrupole对子的类别上,以及在镜像中偶然地对电源谱和双光谱进行分类,O ⁡(3)\mathrm{O}(3)-不变量达到一半,定理4.9的七个不变量将所有类别归为一类;帧坐标与光谱间隙的对等条件差,而不变量不是;测量的稳定性促进者与定理7.3(第9节)一致. 在公共解剖图集的11对双边对齐上,描述器将两个手掌式的一对手掌式形状的对齐确定为一对,其中伪阴性者记录了手掌式,并将其与不同形状的对齐区分开来;诊断器否定了整齐图折叠的两种结构(第9.4节).

blocks.en: The identification of harmonics with binary forms, the spin covering and the Maxwell–Sylvester theorem are classical ( Remark 3.13 ). The contributions of this paper are the reality and parity rule of Lemma 3.6 , which makes reflections visible in the phase of an invariant; the combination of conformal-barycenter normalization with this correspondence into a descriptor that is exactly independent of parameterization, position and scale, with a truncation bound independent of the conformal factor ( Propositions 2.4 and 7.6 ); a complete descriptor through degree two with an explicit pseudo-invariant ( Theorem 4.9 ); the characterization of chirality in degree three by the geometry of the Maxwell axes and the factorization − i ​ R = λ 15 ​ det ( a , b , c ) ​ G -iR=\lambda^{15}\det(a,b,c)\,G ( Theorem 5.2 ); the identification of the residual group of ellipsoid-type alignment, with the proof that no continuous frame exists across the degenerate strata ( Theorem 6.2 ); and two-sided stability with respect to the orbit distance ( Theorem 7.3 ).

blocks.en: The construction is motivated by an unpublished shape analysis of deep perisylvian epilepsy by D. I. Sims, M.-R. Siadat, K. Elisevich and H. Soltanian-Zadeh (2015), which we call SPHARM-COM; Section 10 identifies the freedoms that its radial descriptor left unresolved.

blocks.en: 2.4. Truncation

The conformal gauge has one cost. Conformal maps of elongated or convoluted surfaces have large area distortion, so a small spherical cap may carry a large part of the surface. What is specific here is the pairing with the quaternionic real structure, which makes the parity rule of Lemma 3.6 available, and the explicit normalizations of (iii) and (iv). Two cautions apply. A form in SL 2 ​ ( ℂ ) ⋅ F f \mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{C})\cdot F_{f} is in general not σ l \sigma_{l} -fixed; the rotations of 𝕊 2 \mathbb{S}^{2} are the substitutions by SU ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SU}(2) . blocks.en: Three notions must be kept apart: a generating set generates the invariant algebra; a separating set distinguishes orbits; a feature pool is any list of invariants. blocks.en: For anatomical applications parity must be handled deliberately. Homologous left and right structures are related only approximately by reflection, so raw pseudo-invariants confound pathological asymmetry with laterality; a hemispheric comparison must first reflect one side into a common handedness, after which pseudo-invariants are comparable across sides.
blocks.zh: 对于解剖学应用,必须慎重处理。 同质的左右结构仅通过反射而大致相关,因此原始的伪变量将病理不对称与后性相混淆;半球比较必须首先将一方反映为共同的手性,然后伪变量可以相互比较.

blocks.en: 6. Canonical Frames on the Principal Stratum
blocks.zh: 6. 斯特拉图姆主干线框架

blocks.en: Global polynomial invariants are continuous everywhere but numerous and of high degree. On the open stratum where the lowest informative band has trivial continuous symmetry, a canonical frame reduces the residual group to a finite one. The aligned coordinates number exactly the dimension of the quotient, and the invariant monomials of degree at most three in them form a separating set. This section makes that precise, records the strata where it fails, and states what continuous invariants can and cannot do.
blocks.zh: 全球的多元性变化性无穷无尽,但数量众多,而且程度很高。 在信息最少的带具有微不足道的连续对称性的开放层上,一个犬形框架将剩余组缩小为有限的组. 对齐的坐标号恰好是商号的维度,而其中最多3个学位的不定单数构成了一个分离的集合. 本节对此作了精确的描述,记录了它失败的层次,并说明了持续的不变量能做什么和不能做什么。

blocks.en: 7. Metrics and Stability

blocks.en: The previous sections produce, for a surface S S and a degree L L , a vector of invariants ℐ ⁡ ( c ) \mathcal{I}(c) of the radial descriptor c = f ( L ) ​ ( φ ) c=f^{(L)}(\varphi) , and a vector ℐ 2 ​ ( C ) \mathcal{I}_{2}(C) of the coordinate descriptor. By Corollary 2.3 these vectors do not depend on the parameterization. By Theorems 4.1 and 4.5 they determine the descriptor up to the nuisance rotations. A descriptor that is to be used on measured data needs one more property. Measured shapes carry noise, and two shapes are never exactly congruent. So we must know how the invariants respond to small changes of shape, and conversely how much the shape can change when the invariants change little. The first question asks for continuity of the map from shapes to invariants. The second asks for continuity of its inverse. Both need a distance on the space of shapes modulo the nuisance group. This section defines that distance, proves the two continuity statements, and collects the properties of the descriptor into one theorem.

Parts (ii) and (iii) are the two directions of stability. Part (ii) says that small changes of shape, measured in the orbit distance, produce small changes of the invariants; this is what makes the invariants usable on noisy meshes. Part (iii) says that small changes of the invariants can only come from small changes of shape modulo the nuisance group, uniformly on bounded sets. Together they say that ℐ \mathcal{I} induces a homeomorphism from the image of 𝒦 \mathcal{K} in V L / SO ⁡ ( 3 ) V_{L}/\mathrm{SO}(3) onto its image which is Lipschitz and has a Hölder continuous inverse.

blocks.en: The theorem is the precise form of the claim made in the introduction. Every nuisance freedom of a spherical harmonic description of a surface has been removed exactly: the parameterization by (a), the position and scale by (b) and (c), and the handedness is not discarded but recorded by (d). Nothing has been lost at the level of the truncated coefficients, since (c) says the descriptor is complete for the truncation, and the coordinate model is complete in the limit; the radial reduction and the truncation themselves may lose information about S S . And the result is not only correct on exact data but stable with respect to the coefficients of measured data, by (e). What remains is the numerical realization of each step on triangulated surfaces, which Section 8 addresses.
blocks.zh: 定理是导言中所提主张的确切形式. 球形口琴对表面的描述的每一处扰动自由都被完全删除:参数化方式是(a),位置和尺度是(b)和(c),手性不是丢弃而是(d)记录的。 切变系数水平上没有丢失任何东西,因为(c)说切变的描述符是完整的,坐标模型是完整的极限;切变还原和切变本身可能丢失关于S S的信息. 结果不仅准确的数据是正确的,而且按(e)项计算,测量数据系数也比较稳定。 剩下的是每个步骤在三角地表上的数字实现,第8节涉及这一点。

blocks.en: 8. Computation and Verified Algebra
blocks.zh: 8. 计算和验证代数

blocks.en: The constructions of the previous sections are exact. This section says how each is carried out on a triangulated surface, which quantities must be reported so that a computed descriptor can be trusted, and which algebraic identities were verified independently of any mesh.

blocks.en: 8.1. From a mesh to a centered parameterization
blocks.zh: 8.1. 从网格到中心参数化

blocks.en: The input is a triangulated surface S h S_{h} with vertices p 1 , … , p n ∈ ℝ 3 p_{1},\dots,p_{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} . It must be a connected closed combinatorial manifold with n − e + t = 2 n-e+t=2 , free of degenerate faces, and consistently oriented; its realization in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} is assumed free of self-intersections, so that S h S_{h} approximates a smoothly embedded two-sphere. The first step is a discrete conformal map ψ h : S h → 𝕊 2 \psi_{h}\colon S_{h}\to\mathbb{S}^{2} , p i ↦ u i p_{i}\mapsto u_{i} , without flipped triangles, obtained by minimizing a discrete conformal energy on the sphere [ 17 , 11 ] ; its residual freedom is, up to discretization error, a Möbius transformation.

blocks.en: The second step is the discrete form of Lemma 2.1 . The pulled-back area measure is μ h = ∑ i w i ​ δ u i \mu_{h}=\sum_{i}w_{i}\delta_{u_{i}} with w i w_{i} the fraction of the area of S h S_{h} attributed to p i p_{i} . By Remark 2.2 it has a unique conformal barycenter x h x_{h} provided max i ⁡ w i < 1 / 2 \max_{i}w_{i}<1/2 , which must be checked. Figure 4 (a) shows the outcome. The power spectrum and the bispectrum stay at chance at every noise level, including σ = 0 \sigma=0 , because they are functions of invariants that coincide on all four classes. The O ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{O}(3) -invariants reach one half: they separate A A from B B but not a class from its mirror image, as Proposition 5.1 predicts. The seven invariants of Theorem 4.9 and the frame coordinates classify all four classes without error at σ = 0 \sigma=0 and with accuracy above 0.97 0.97 at σ = 0.02 \sigma=0.02 . For larger noise all descriptors degrade, and the ordering is unchanged. The per-coefficient level σ = 0.05 \sigma=0.05 corresponds to a noise vector of about 14 % 14\% of ∥ c ∥ \lVert c\rVert , comparable to the separation | ε | ≈ 0.037 \lvert\varepsilon\rvert\approx 0.037 between mirror classes.

blocks.en: The last experiment runs the mesh pipeline of Section 8 on real anatomy. The meshes are the eleven bilateral pairs of BodyParts3D, a public anatomical atlas of one adult male: hippocampus, amygdala, putamen, globus pallidus, thalamus, parahippocampal gyrus, testis, kidney, adrenal gland, caudate nucleus and lateral ventricle. All 22 22 meshes pass the preflight of Section 8.1 . Each was remeshed isotropically to 2800 2800 – 2900 2900 vertices, since the atlas meshes contain triangles with angles below 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} ; the remeshed surfaces pass the preflight again. The spherical map is the harmonic map of the punctured surface to the plane [ 11 ] followed by the harmonic-energy flow with cotangent weights of Section 8.1 , with Möbius centering after every ten steps. Coefficients through L = 6 L=6 of the radial model were computed with round weights and divided by the mean radius f 0 f_{0} , so that the descriptor is scale-free; ∥ c ∥ \lVert c\rVert denotes the norm of bands 1 1 to 6 6 of the left structure, and all distances below are divided by it. On the synthetic surface of Section 8.6 this implementation reproduces the quadrupole eigenvalues and the dipole norm of Table 2 to three digits. The scripts are Online Resource 4.

blocks.en: The experiments give a consistent picture. The power spectrum and the bispectrum are stable but incomplete and blind to reflections. Frames are complete on the principal stratum but ill-conditioned near its boundary. The polynomial invariants are complete, record chirality, and are uniformly Lipschitz; their inverse is Lipschitz on the principal stratum and Hölder of exponent 1 / 2 1/2 at the strata where the stabilizer jumps. On real anatomy the same invariants separate mirror-image pairs from asymmetric pairs, and the diagnostics identify the surfaces on which the conformal parameterization cannot be trusted.
blocks.zh: 实验给出了一致的画面. 动力谱和双光谱虽然稳定但不完整,对反射视而不见. 主要地层的框架已完整,但边界附近条件恶劣。 多元性无变化体是完整的,记录的奇异性,是一致的利普希茨;它们的反面是利普希茨在主层上,在稳定器跳动的平面上为1 / 2 1/2. 在真正的解剖学上,同样的不变量将镜像对从不对称对中分离出来,诊断结果可以识别出无法信赖的符合参数化的表面.

blocks.en: The central contribution is a quotient-theoretic formulation of spherical-harmonic shape analysis for genus-zero surfaces in which every nuisance freedom is a group action and every step is exact: conformal barycenter normalization for the parameterization, polynomial invariants of a compact group for rotation, weighted projectivization for scale. Within that formulation we have proved a complete descriptor through degree two, characterized chirality in degree three and tied it to the locus ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} of genus-two curves with an elliptic involution, constructed separating frame coordinates on the principal strata of both models with the residual Klein four-group made explicit, recorded the size of continuous separating invariants, and proved the metric and stability statements that certify the descriptor.
blocks.zh: 中心贡献是球形-协和体形状分析的商数-理论配方,其中每一次扰动自由都是群体动作,每一步都是精确的:一个紧凑的组合的参数化变态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态态 在这种表述中,我们通过第二度证明了一个完整的描述符,在第三度中具有特征的特征特征,并用椭圆进化法将它与双子曲线的L 2(mathcal{L}_{2}) 连接在一起,在两种模型的主要层上构建了分离框架坐标,其余的克莱因四组明确了,记录了连续分离的变异物的大小,并证明了验证描述符的度和稳定性说明。

blocks.en: SPHARM-COM represents a closed surface by the distance from the center of mass, expanded in spherical harmonics through degree 30 30 with respect to an approximately area-preserving parameterization, followed by supervised selection of individual coefficients, which concentrated in bands 1 1 through 6 6 . Replacing the coordinate functions by the distance removes ambient rotation and reduces three channels to one, but it does not remove the reparameterization freedom: with an area-preserving parameterization that freedom is infinite-dimensional, and even after a canonical parameterization a residual SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SO}(3) remains. An individual coefficient is therefore a function of the map, not of the surface. Coefficients computed from an area-preserving parameterization cannot be converted into the descriptor; the surface must be reparameterized and centered as in Section 8 . The present construction retains the same kind of scalar representation in the radial model, the distance from a center, and quotients exactly the freedoms that remained; for the bands actually used, Theorem 4.9 gives a complete descriptor of the truncation through degree two with seven invariants, the sextic invariants and R ^ \hat{R} complete band three as an isolated band, and Theorem 6.2 (a) gives a complete real-analytic descriptor on the principal stratum through any degree. The coordinate model additionally retains the direction information the radial reduction discards and is faithful in the all-band limit. The pseudo-invariants isolate mirror asymmetry, which an analysis of raw radial coefficients neither identifies nor controls, and Remark 4.2 shows that coefficient-space interpolation, used there for augmentation, is not intrinsic on the quotient. Methodological details of that manuscript are used here: radialization, the truncation degree, the coefficient selection and the augmentation. Its cohort, classification results and data are not; a quantitative comparison on any cohort is left to it and to future joint work.
blocks.zh: SPHARM-COM代表从质量中心到距离的闭合表面,通过30度/30,在大约保面积参数化方面扩展成球形谐波,然后监督选择单个系数,这些系数集中在1至6区。 以距离取代坐标函数可以移除环境旋转,将三个通道减少到一个,但是它并没有去掉重新参数化的自由:使用一个区域保值参数化,自由是无限维的,即使在一个犬形参数化后,一个剩余SO(3)\mathrm{SO}(3)仍然保留. 因此,单个系数是地图的函数,而不是表面的函数。 通过区域保值参数化计算出来的系数不能转换成描述符;表面必须像第8节那样重新调整和中心化。 目前构造在射线模型中保留了同一种划线代表,距中心距离,以及精确的计算保留的自由度;对于实际使用的波段,定理4.9给出了通过二等分7个不变量,性别不变量和R^\hat{R}完整的波段三作为孤立的波段的截断的完整描述,定理6.2(a)给出通过任何程度对主层的完整真实描述. 坐标模型还保留了光圈还原丢弃物的方向信息,并忠实于全波段限制. 伪不变量将镜像不对称隔离,对原始射线系数的分析既不识别也不控制,Remark 4.2显示,用于放大的系数-空间插值在商数上并不内在. 本文使用该手稿的方法细节:射线化、截断度、系数选择和增量。 它的组群、分类结果和数据都不是;对任何组群的定量比较留给它和未来的联合工作。

blocks.en: Three problems remain open. The first is a global polynomial separating set for W L W_{L} , L ≥ 2 L\geq 2 , of size comparable to dim 𝒬 L \dim\mathcal{Q}_{L} ; covariant generation and null-cone analysis are the natural tools, and the Maxwell-axis reduction of Lemma 3.6 (ii) suggests a route through the first fundamental theorem for configurations of unoriented lines. The second is the sharp Hölder exponent in Theorem 7.3 (iii) and its dependence on the strata; the bi-Lipschitz theory of [ 8 ] may apply after adaptation. The third is the geometry of the real band-three locus in ℙ ( 2 , 4 , 6 , 10 ) ​ ( ℝ ) \mathbb{P}_{(2,4,6,10)}(\mathbb{R}) . Its intersection with ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{2} is the achiral locus of Theorem 5.2 . Which real harmonics of degree three have a sextic whose curve has an elliptic subcover of higher degree, and what configuration of their Maxwell axes this imposes, is open; unlike the degree-two case, no reflection is involved, and no anatomical meaning should be assigned to such loci before empirical validation.

blocks.en: The steps of the construction are explicit maps: the conformal barycenter, the correspondence Ψ \Psi , the invariants of Section 4 and the gauge 17 . By Theorem 7.6 , the class [ 𝒟 L ​ ( S ) ] [\mathcal{D}_{L}(S)] they compute does not depend on the parameterization, the position or the scale, so they can serve as fixed input layers for learning on shapes. Such learning and a mesh-level validation on anatomical data are natural next steps; the present paper validates the pipeline on synthetic surfaces and on a single atlas subject.
blocks.zh: 建造步骤是清晰的地图:有条理的Barycenter、通信 \\Psi、第4节的变数和标尺 17。 根据定理7.6,它们计算出的类[DL(S)][\mathcal{D}_{L}(S)]不取决于参数化,位置或尺度,因此它们可以作为学习形状的固定输入层. 这种学习以及对解剖数据进行网格级验证是下一个自然步骤;本文验证合成表面和单一地图集主题上的管道。
